headline: Cupid Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Cupid Limited has informed the Exchange about Conversion of up to the total outstanding 56,00,000 Warrants, in one or more tranches, into an equivalent number of Equity Shares of Baazar Style Retail Limited.
